_comment: cc-quota-guard message catalog. Only text a HUMAN reads is ever sourced from here (cc-run's terminal lines, the hook's systemMessage) — never what Claude itself is instructed (the reason field, RULES/PROMPT text), which stays English always regardless of language. Placeholders are Python str.format() {name} fields; keep the {braces} exactly, translate everything else, and put them in whatever word order the language needs — order does not matter to str.format(). See scripts/i18n.py for how this file is loaded and README.md's Language section for how to add a new one.
soft_stop: ⛔ Quota threshold reached ({label} {pct}%) — Claude is wrapping up cleanly. Reset: {resets_at}
hard_stop_reverted: ⛔ HARD quota threshold ({label} {pct}%) — item reverted. Reset: {resets_at}
hard_stop_clean: ⛔ HARD quota threshold ({label} {pct}%) — clean stop. Reset: {resets_at}
hard_abort_on_git: → [cc-run] --enable-hard-abort passed: hard-abort is ON for this run (git stash on a HARD threshold).
hard_abort_on_nogit: ⚠️  [cc-run] --enable-hard-abort passed but this isn't a git repo: hard-abort will fall back to a clean stop.
hard_abort_off: → [cc-run] hard-abort not forced here — using your plugin/project configuration (built-in default: off).
archived_progress: ℹ️  [cc-run] Previous run's finished progress.md archived (this project already had a completed run here).
round_timeout: ⚠️  [cc-run] No progress for {waited}s (limit $CC_ROUND_TIMEOUT={max_wait}s) — assuming this round is stuck (e.g. the network dropped mid-request) and ending it so it can be retried.
round_failed_retry: ⚠️  [cc-run] Round ended abnormally (exit {status}), attempt {attempt}/{max_retries} — likely a transient issue (e.g. network down). Retrying in {backoff}s.
giving_up: ❌ [cc-run] Round failed (exit {status}) {count} times in a row — giving up.
giving_up_hint: Check your network / the claude CLI, then resume manually: claude -c   (or re-run cc-run — .cc-quota/progress.md has what's left).
hard_reverted_sleep: ⏸️  [cc-run] HARD quota threshold ({window}). '{aborted}' was reverted. Reset: {resets}. Sleeping {secs}s → resuming ~{wake}.
threshold_sleep: ⏸️  [cc-run] Quota threshold ({window}, mode={mode}). Reset: {resets}. Sleeping {secs}s → resuming ~{wake}.
ended_own: ℹ️  [cc-run] No STOP marker and no DONE signal — Claude ended the turn on its own. Stopping.
ended_own_hint: (If you expected it to continue, check .cc-quota/progress.md and the terminal output.)
